info.name: Ecom Platform (auth + ecom-api via nginx)
info.description:
End-to-end collection for the microservices platform via the nginx gateway at {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:3008). India-only storefront (INR), payments via Cashfree.

AUTH IS PASSWORDLESS (OTP) — signup and login are the SAME flow:
  1. POST /auth/otp {email}  -> emails a 6-digit code via Mailpit (no token yet)
  2. Read the code from Mailpit ({{mailpitUrl}}, default http://localhost:8028)
  3. POST /auth/verify-otp {email,otp,name?,mobile?}  -> creates the account if new, returns the token

Uses BEARER tokens throughout (saved to {{accessToken}}); Bearer requests are CSRF-exempt. Cookie delivery + CSRF is shown once ('Cookie mode example').

COMMERCE FLOW (Ecom API): List products -> Add to cart (X-Cart-Id for guests) -> login -> Merge cart -> Create address -> Checkout (returns a Cashfree paymentSessionId) -> complete payment in the app with the Cashfree JS SDK. The webhook is the source of truth; the 'Cashfree webhook' request simulates it locally (signs the body with {{cashfreeSecretKey}}).

Admin (seeded admin@example.com): manage products, per-country prices, shipping rates, and order fulfilment / refunds / returns.

IDs are auto-saved by test scripts: {{productId}}, {{cartId}}, {{addressId}}, {{orderId}}, {{returnId}}.

item.name: Cookie mode example (X-Auth-Source: cookie) — saves CSRF

request.description: THE single cookie example. Everything else uses Bearer (CSRF-exempt). In cookie mode the server sets HttpOnly access/refresh cookies + a readable csrf_token cookie (also returned as data.csrfToken). Cookie-mode POST/PATCH/DELETE must send X-CSRF-Token: {{csrfToken}} or you get 403.
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. Bearer clients pass the token in the body; cookie clients rely on the refresh cookie.
Revokes this refresh token + denylists the access token's session (instant revocation).
Revokes every session for the user.

Turns the cart into a pending order and creates a Cashfree order. Returns paymentSessionId (for the Cashfree JS SDK), appId, and mode. Saves {{orderId}}.

PUBLIC. Simulates Cashfree's server-to-server callback (the real one is sent by Cashfree to $PUBLIC_BASE_URL/api/payments/webhook). The pre-request script signs the body with {{cashfreeSecretKey}}; on success the order flips to paid, stock decrements, and the cart clears. In production you do NOT call this — Cashfree does.

request.description: Paginated order history for the current user.
Order detail (poll this after checkout until status = paid).
Optional reason (no image). Pending → cancelled (order expires). Paid & not shipped → full refund + restock. Shipped/delivered → blocked (use a return).
For shipped/delivered/fulfilled orders. Saves {{returnId}}. Upload evidence images with the next request.
Attach up to 5 evidence images (JPG/PNG/WEBP/GIF, 5 MB each) to a return. Body is form-data with repeated `images` file fields.
Streams one image (owner or admin). {{returnImageFile}} is the filename part of an object key from the return's images[] (the last path segment).
Fulfillment track only: paid→fulfilled|shipped, fulfilled→shipped, shipped→delivered. Money-states (refunded/cancelled) are rejected here — use cancel/refund.
Optional reason. Same money/stock rules as the customer cancel.

Server-Sent Events stream of live order/return changes for the admin panel. EventSource can't send headers, so the token goes in ?access_token. Open it and watch events arrive as you change orders/returns in another tab.
Omit amountMinor for a FULL refund (restores stock → refunded). Partial keeps status paid and bumps refundedMinor. Cashfree refunds settle asynchronously.
action: approve | reject | receive | refund. Money + stock only move on 'refund' (after the goods are 'received').

item.description: Everything under /api via the nginx gateway. Typical flow: List products → Add item to cart → (login) → Merge cart → Create address → Checkout → simulate the Cashfree webhook → poll the order → admin fulfil/ship/deliver → cancel/refund/returns.
